# Setup
```{r}
suppressMessages({
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
  library(HDF5Array)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(data.table)
  library(patchwork)
  library(supeRwig)
  source("mega_junction_plot_retina_adult_fetal_backend_code.R")
})
```

# Load Data
## Load EiaD Gene Counts (cpm)
```{r}
cts <- loadHDF5SummarizedExperiment("~/data/vogda/eiad/se_h5/se_gene_cpm_human.20261013.hdf5/")
```

## Load EiaD Exon Counts (cpm)
```{r}
exon <- loadHDF5SummarizedExperiment("~/data/vogda/eiad/se_h5/se_exon_cpm_human.20261015.hdf5/")
row.names(exon) <- gsub("ENSE\\d+\\.\\d+:","", row.names(exon))
```

## Load Eiad Splice Junction (SJ) Counts (cpm)
```{r}
sj <- loadHDF5SummarizedExperiment("~/data/vogda/eiad/se_h5/se_sj_human.20261007.hdf5/")
```

## Load Retina Adult vs Retina Fetal Diff Testing
```{r}
diff <- readRDS('data/eiad_retina_adult_vs_fetal_tx_diff.20261014.rds')
```

# Top Splicing Diff 

annot "1" means known, "0" means novel
```{r}
diff$sj_topsplice_exon |> 
  head(100) |> 
  relocate(jid, logFC) |> 
  DT::datatable()
```

# Set Loop
```{r}
junctions <- diff$sj_topsplice_exon |>  head(100) |> pull(jid)
up_delta <- 1000
down_delta <- 1000
logFC_set <- -10
```


# Mega Plot Write to SVG
```{r, fig.height = 9, fig.width=18, warning=FALSE, messages = FALSE}
 
system("mkdir -p adult_retina_vs_fetal_retina_diff_junction_plots")
for (j in junctions){
  suppressMessages(plot <- (mega_maker(j)))
  gene <- diff$sj_topsplice_exon |> filter(jid == j) |> pull(SYMBOL)
  ggsave(plot, filename = paste0("adult_retina_vs_fetal_retina_diff_junction_plots/", gene, "-", j, ".svg"), units = "in", width = 18, height = 9, device = svg)
}
```
